character.name:
Create a dark shadow-figure pixel-art character sprite of Adam for the introduction sequence of a moody top-down narrative JRPG. He must match Ata’s overall sprite logic: compact grounded proportions, small top-down RPG character scale, simple readable silhouette, and the same general body proportion style as the game’s main character. He should not be chibi, but he also should not be tall, realistic, elongated, or highly detailed. Keep the sprite compact and restrained.

Adam is an adult male early-biblical figure. He has messy medium-length dark hair and a short dark beard. His face should be mostly obscured and simplified, with minimal visible features. Expression neutral and unreadable. He should appear as a dark shadowy figure, not a fully lit character. Use a very dark grayscale / charcoal palette with only subtle shading for form separation.

He wears a rough sleeveless dark tunic with a frayed hem, tied at the waist with a rope belt. He is barefoot, with bare arms and lower legs visible. Keep anatomy simple and understated. Do not overdefine muscles, facial structure, or clothing folds.

Generate him in 4 directions: south/front, west/left side, east/right side, and north/back. Neutral standing pose, standard turnaround sheet. Black or transparent background. No text, no labels, no scenery, no UI, no extra objects.

Style: minimalist moody pixel art, low-contrast shadow figure, subtle grayscale shading, clean silhouette, compact proportions, simple sprite readability, consistent with a small narrative JRPG character.
